Aprašymas:
Hand-built red stoneware sculpture vase, approx. 25 cm high. 

Inspired by sea spray, eroded cliffs, earth, and sandy shorelines, CliffSide combines a raw, textured surface with a deep earthy red finish.

The vase can hold water, but as with handmade ceramics, slight dampness, mold, or occasional leakage may occur. For long-term use, dried flowers or displaying it simply as a sculptural object is recommended.

Each piece is handmade from natural clay and glaze, so subtle variations in texture, color, and finish are part of its character and may differ slightly from the photographs.
